messages:
jamie_cs: quick recap from three onboarding sessions (LumenCare, Parkside, Meridian). recurring feedback threads 94 dumping raw notes. tagging @leila_pm for triage and @omar_pd for quick PD feasibility check.
leila_pm: thanks jamie. paste the bullets, mark renewal risk if any. brief is fine.
jamie_cs: raw notes:
```
- LumenCare (ACC: LUM-210): customers report model swaps during peak causing inconsistent outputs; asks for automatic fallback to lighter model + better error messaging. (P1, pilot-to-paid end of month)
- Parkside (ACC: PS-88): embedding mismatch: some uploaded docs return empty vector; needs example upload workflow + sample sanitized csv; investigating whether it's a formatting issue (P2)
- Meridian (ACC: MER-501): wants route-level alerting when token usage > threshold and ability to pause routes; worried about surprise charges on pilot (P1, strong renewal risk)
```
tara_support: suggestion — include whether CS already tried repro steps and attach a minimal repro or log snippet; helps triage.
omar_pd: for fallback: we can ship a soft-fallback config (switch model family on error) in 1 sprint; alerting/pause will need backend work ~2 sprints. embedding checklist + upload samples = doc change today.
jamie_cs: proposed capture template for CS paste:
```
problem: <one-line>
signal: <how observed 94 customer report / logs / frequency>
accounts: <acct ids>
impact: <business impact + renewal risk Y/N>
workaround: <accepted temp fix>
urgency: P1/P2/P3
quote: "customer quote"
```
feedback-bot: added 3 items to Feedback Board 94 https://docs.redwood.com/feedback-board (tags: onboarding, billing, embeddings). auto-id: FB-8459, FB-8460, FB-8461.
leila_pm: i'll triage this afternoon and add a one-line ROI impact for execs. jamie, can you add whether Meridian will accept a 30-day credit as mitigation? that info helps renewal team.
jamie_cs: noted 94 i'll follow up with Meridian and update tracker. thanks all. :thumbsup:
